newsitem.title: USA: NAPM-New York business conditions 50.8 in May.
newsitem.headline: NAPM-New York business conditions 50.8 in May.

text.p: The National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) index of New York-area business conditions slipped to 50.8 in May from 50.9 in April.
The New York-area non-manufacturing conditions index also slid to 49.3 in May from 49.4 the month before.
Manufacturing-sector conditions inched up to 64.1 from 64.0 in April, the report said.
An index above 50 denotes growth, NAPM said.
Looking forward to the upcoming six months, purchasers' optimism decreased in May, NAPM said.
NAPM's New York business outlook index, which looks ahead about six months, read 64.9 in May compared to 67.4 in April, the report said.
The regional business conditions index is at its lowest level since June 1995 when it stood at 47.7.
